_source: Generated locally (Flux 2 dev, seed 20260824) for the ai-registry cinematic-language trials, 2026-08-24. We wrote the generating prompt, so the intent is known — but only fields that are ALSO unambiguous in the rendered image are graded here. A prompt is a request, not a label.
